titulo.alumno: Lesson 49: final exam of the B2 level

texto: This test contains **28 items**: 11 questions on two short readings and 17 vocabulary and grammar exercises from chapters 38 to 49, in multiple-choice, gap-fill and translation formats.

The score serves to decide which chapters to review; on its own it doesn't certify a B2 level. First try to understand each reading without opening the translation, and then go back to the text to find the evidence for your answer.

piezas.titulo: Reading · Should buses get priority? (teaching text)

frases.estudio: Trong khu phố nơi tôi sống, nhiều con đường thường ùn tắc vào buổi sáng.
frases.alumno: In the neighbourhood where I live, many streets are often congested in the morning.

frases.estudio: Theo tôi, thành phố nên ưu tiên xe buýt ở một số tuyến đông đúc, thay vì chỉ mở rộng đường cho ô tô.
frases.alumno: In my view, the city should give buses priority on some busy routes, instead of only widening the roads for cars.

frases.estudio: Trước hết, một làn xe buýt riêng có thể giúp xe buýt ít bị chậm vì tắc đường.
frases.alumno: First, a dedicated bus lane can help buses get held up less by traffic.

frases.estudio: Nhờ đó, giờ đến có thể ổn định hơn, nhất là với người phải đi làm đúng giờ hoặc đổi nhiều chuyến.
frases.alumno: This way, arrival times can be more stable, especially for those who must get to work on time or change buses several times.

frases.estudio: Có người lo rằng dành một làn cho xe buýt sẽ khiến ô tô có ít chỗ đi hơn.
frases.alumno: Some people worry that setting aside a lane for buses will leave cars less room.

frases.estudio: Đây là một bất tiện cần tính đến, nhất là trong thời gian đầu.
frases.alumno: It is a drawback that must be taken into account, especially at the beginning.

frases.estudio: Tuy nhiên, nếu xe buýt chạy đáng tin cậy hơn, nhiều người có thể cân nhắc dùng xe buýt thay vì lái xe riêng.
frases.alumno: However, if buses run more reliably, more people might consider taking the bus instead of driving.

frases.estudio: Giải pháp này không phù hợp như nhau với mọi con đường, vì vậy cần xem xét nhu cầu của từng tuyến.
frases.alumno: This solution doesn't suit every street equally, so the needs of each route must be studied.

frases.estudio: Tóm lại, thành phố nên thử ở một số tuyến, theo dõi kết quả rồi mới quyết định có mở rộng hay không.
frases.alumno: In short, the city should try it on some routes, watch the results and then decide whether to extend it.

frases.estudio: THÔNG BÁO: Quy trình đề nghị hoàn tiền khóa học dưới đây là quy định nội bộ mô phỏng của công ty An Phát.
frases.alumno: NOTICE: the following procedure for requesting a course refund is a simulated internal rule of the An Phát company.

frases.estudio: Nhân viên phải nộp hồ sơ cho phòng Nhân sự trong vòng mười lăm ngày làm việc sau khi khóa học kết thúc.
frases.alumno: The employee must submit the request to Human Resources within fifteen working days after the course ends.

frases.estudio: Hồ sơ gồm đơn đề nghị, hóa đơn có ghi rõ từng khoản và giấy chứng nhận hoàn thành khóa học.
frases.alumno: The request must include the form, an itemised invoice and the course completion certificate.

frases.estudio: Nếu học phí từ mười triệu đồng trở lên, nhân viên phải xin Ban Tài chính phê duyệt trước khi đăng ký.
frases.alumno: If the tuition is ten million đồng or more, the employee must obtain Finance's approval before enrolling.

frases.estudio: Nếu hồ sơ thiếu giấy tờ, phòng Nhân sự sẽ yêu cầu bổ sung và cho người nộp năm ngày làm việc để hoàn thành.
frases.alumno: If documents are missing, Human Resources will ask for them to be completed and will give the applicant five working days to do so.

frases.estudio: Quá thời hạn đó mà không có phản hồi, yêu cầu sẽ được đóng.
frases.alumno: If that deadline passes without a reply, the request will be closed.

frases.estudio: Khóa học chưa được duyệt trước khi đăng ký không đủ điều kiện hoàn tiền, trừ khóa đào tạo bắt buộc do công ty yêu cầu.
frases.alumno: A course not approved before enrolment is not eligible for a refund, unless it is compulsory training requested by the company.

frases.estudio: Khoản hoàn tiền chỉ bao gồm học phí; chi phí đi lại, ăn uống và tài liệu cá nhân không được tính.
frases.alumno: The refund covers only tuition; travel, meals and personal materials are not included.

frases.estudio: Nếu khóa học bị hủy, nhân viên phải báo cho phòng Nhân sự trong vòng hai ngày và gửi giấy xác nhận hủy.
frases.alumno: If the course is cancelled, the employee must notify Human Resources within two days and send a proof of cancellation.

pregunta.texto: What is the author's thesis?

opciones.texto: Give buses priority on some routes and assess the result.
opciones.explicacion: It summarises the proposal and the final condition.

opciones.texto: Eliminate all cars from the city.
opciones.explicacion: The text doesn't propose a total ban.
The author questions limiting oneself to that measure.
That proposal doesn't appear.

pregunta.texto: What possible benefit does the text mention?

opciones.texto: That arrival times are more stable.
opciones.explicacion: It's the consequence pointed out in the fourth sentence.
Price isn't mentioned.

opciones.texto: That traffic disappears from all streets.
opciones.explicacion: The proposal is limited to some routes.
The text mentions those who do change buses.

pregunta.texto: What drawback does the author concede?

opciones.texto: Less room may remain for cars.
opciones.explicacion: The author recognises that concern as something to be considered.

opciones.texto: Buses can't run through narrow streets.
opciones.explicacion: That isn't claimed.
The possible effect cited is the opposite.

opciones.texto: The city will have to close public transport.
opciones.explicacion: It doesn't appear in the text.

pregunta.texto: What relation does «Tuy nhiên» express in the seventh sentence?

opciones.texto: It introduces a response that qualifies the earlier worry.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the drawback with a possible benefit.

opciones.texto: It adds a second, equal drawback.
opciones.explicacion: The idea that follows changes direction.
It doesn't introduce the cause of the traffic.
The conclusion begins with «Tóm lại».

pregunta.texto: What does he propose doing before extending the measure?

opciones.texto: Trying it on some routes and observing the results.
opciones.explicacion: The author recommends assessing before deciding.

opciones.texto: Applying it immediately to all streets.
opciones.explicacion: The text asks for a limited trial.
That condition isn't mentioned.
It contradicts the proposal.

pregunta.texto: Does the author present bus priority as an identical solution for all streets?

opciones.texto: No; he says the needs of each route must be considered.
opciones.explicacion: The second-to-last sentence expressly limits its scope.

opciones.texto: Yes; he recommends applying it on all streets.
opciones.explicacion: The text says it doesn't work equally on all of them.

opciones.texto: Yes; he claims it only works on empty streets.
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't set that condition.

opciones.texto: No; he proposes closing all routes.
opciones.explicacion: That's not the author's alternative.

pregunta.texto: What is the usual deadline for submitting the request?

opciones.texto: Fifteen working days after the course ends.
opciones.explicacion: The notice counts the deadline from the end of the course.
That isn't the deadline stated for submitting the file.

opciones.texto: Two days after the course starts.
opciones.explicacion: That deadline refers to the cancellation notice.
The five days are for completing missing documents.

pregunta.texto: Which documents are included in the request?

opciones.texto: Form, itemised invoice and completion certificate.
opciones.explicacion: The notice lists those three documents.
The invoice alone is not enough.

opciones.texto: A letter from the boss and a transport ticket.
opciones.explicacion: They are not the required documents.
Food is excluded from the refund.

pregunta.texto: What special condition applies to courses costing ten million đồng or more?

opciones.texto: Finance must approve them before enrolment.
opciones.explicacion: The approval deadline comes before enrolling.

opciones.texto: They are approved automatically at the end.
opciones.explicacion: There's no automatic approval.
The refund covers tuition, under the conditions indicated.

opciones.texto: Notice must be given two days after the course starts.
opciones.explicacion: That deadline refers to cancellation.

pregunta.texto: What exception allows a refund to be requested even without prior approval?

opciones.texto: That the company required that training.
opciones.explicacion: It's the exception introduced by «trừ».

opciones.texto: That the employee bought personal materials.
opciones.explicacion: Those materials aren't refunded.

opciones.texto: That the request is submitted late.
opciones.explicacion: The deadline remains compulsory.

opciones.texto: That the course costs less than ten million.
opciones.explicacion: The notice doesn't present it as an exception.

pregunta.texto: Which expense is excluded?

opciones.explicacion: The refund is limited to tuition.
That's the expense that can be included.
It's documentation, not a refundable expense.
It's also required documentation.

pregunta.texto: Turning an activity into a topic · ch. 38

frase.texto: ___ học ngoại ngữ cần nhiều thời gian.

opciones.explicacion: việc + verb presents the activity.
It's used with names of positive feelings.
It forms a correlative pair.
It's a classifier for books.

pregunta.texto: A feeling of pride · ch. 38

frase.texto: Con cái là ___ tự hào của cha mẹ.

opciones.explicacion: niềm tự hào = pride, a positive feeling.
It introduces an activity or a fact.
It usually appears with negative feelings.
It's not the collocation for this sentence.

pregunta.texto: Unmet expectation · ch. 39

frase.texto: ___ tôi phải kiểm tra lại trước khi gửi, nhưng tôi vội quá.

opciones.explicacion: Lẽ ra… phải…, nhưng… sets what was expected against what happened.
It means «thank goodness that».
It introduces a hypothesis.
It means «unless».

pregunta.texto: As long as · ch. 39

frase.texto: Tôi sẽ ký hợp đồng, ___ lương không thấp hơn mười lăm triệu.

opciones.explicacion: It introduces the condition that is required.
It means «unless».
It indicates that something nearly happened.
It introduces an unwanted eventuality.

pregunta.texto: What does it mean? · ch. 40

opciones.texto: Each person bears the consequences of what they do.
opciones.explicacion: ai… nấy sets the relationship between people and actions.
It reverses the meaning.
It doesn't express equality of task.
It isn't a question.

pregunta.texto: Direct cause · ch. 41

frase.texto: Hút thuốc lá ___ nhiều bệnh nguy hiểm.

opciones.explicacion: gây ra introduces a consequence that is caused.
It usually presents a favourable cause.
It introduces a goal.
It means «instead».

pregunta.texto: Instead · ch. 41

frase.texto: Tôi không uống nước ngọt nữa. ___, tôi uống trà.

opciones.explicacion: It introduces an alternative that takes the place of another.
It rephrases something.
It presents a consequence.
It adds information.

pregunta.texto: Even more so · ch. 42

frase.texto: Người lớn còn thấy khó, ___ là trẻ em.

opciones.explicacion: A còn…, huống chi B expresses «how much more so B».
It means «anyway».
It expresses a firm assumption.
It introduces a condition.

pregunta.texto: Nobody · ch. 43

frase.texto: Tôi hỏi cả lớp nhưng ___ ai biết cả.

opciones.explicacion: không ai… cả = nobody.
It means «everyone» in other patterns.
It can express «each» or past experience.
It doesn't form the correct negation here.

pregunta.texto: What does the figure report? · ch. 43

frase.texto: Tỷ lệ thất nghiệp giảm từ năm phần trăm xuống bốn phần trăm.

opciones.texto: The unemployment rate fell from five to four per cent.
opciones.explicacion: giảm từ… xuống… expresses the change between two values.

opciones.texto: The rate rose from four to five per cent.
opciones.explicacion: It reverses the values and the direction.

opciones.texto: The total rate is nine per cent.
opciones.explicacion: The values don't add up.
The statement indicates a reduction.

pregunta.texto: If «quốc» gives the idea of country and «kỳ» that of flag, what does «quốc kỳ» mean? · ch. 44

opciones.explicacion: It's the lexicalised compound for a country's flag.
It's called quốc ca.
That's not the meaning of the compound.
It doesn't correspond to kỳ.

pregunta.texto: Thanks to · ch. 45

frase.texto: Doanh thu tăng ___ thị trường xuất khẩu mở rộng.

opciones.explicacion: It introduces the favourable cause presented in the sentence.
It introduces a goal.
It introduces a conditional exception.
It expresses «how much more so».

pregunta.texto: In the headline «Bộ Y tế: Dịch cúm đang tăng», what function do the colons fulfil here? · ch. 45

opciones.texto: They introduce an attribution: the source and what it communicates.
opciones.explicacion: It's a possible reading of this particular headline, not a universal equivalence.
That's not the use it has here.
The headline is not interrogative.
There is no quote from a work.

pregunta.texto: Which expresses polite disagreement? · ch. 46

opciones.texto: Tôi hiểu ý anh, nhưng tôi nghĩ hơi khác một chút.
opciones.explicacion: It acknowledges the position and then qualifies it.
It's a blunt retort.
It's a flat negation.
It refuses to listen to the other person.

pregunta.texto: Which phrase formally asks the Management for something? · ch. 47

opciones.texto: Kính mong Ban Giám đốc xem xét và chấp thuận.
opciones.explicacion: It's a respectful request for the Management to consider and approve it.
It's a personal and informal closing.
It's addressed to someone with familiarity.
It's colloquial and inappropriate for this register.

pregunta.texto: Which proverb links perseverance to a result achieved? · ch. 48

opciones.texto: Có công mài sắt, có ngày nên kim.
opciones.explicacion: Constant effort can produce a difficult result.
It describes leaving things to the last moment.
It alludes to the influence of companies.
It talks about solidarity.

pregunta.texto: In «Hai tiếng cơ?», what does the particle «cơ» add here? · ch. 48

opciones.texto: Emphasis or surprise at the amount: «two hours, no less?».
opciones.explicacion: The nuance depends on intonation and context; here it expresses surprise.
It isn't an order.

opciones.texto: The idea that something is free.
opciones.explicacion: That meaning doesn't appear.
It isn't a farewell formula.

pregunta.texto: Put the words in order.

piezas.traduccion: Each person bears the consequences of what they do.
